_readme: Sample answer file for the interactive tasks in fleet-component-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.

Keyed by cmdlet name. Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer is called 4 times in this plan (VCFMS, Log Management, VCF Automation, Telemetry, in that order) - each value is an array of answer sets, one per invocation.

Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer's own prompts (pick a backup group, optional per-component custom picks, final Y/N) vary with how many backups/components are found on the SFTP server - the values below assume a single matching backup and no custom overrides, and MUST be reviewed against your own environment's real prompts before use.

Confirm-ManualStep is different from every other key here: its value is a single FLAT array of pre-approved -AnswerKey strings, not an array of answer sets. This plan has 7 manual 'Press Enter once X is done' gates (two - vcfms-binary-staging-complete/vcfa-binary-staging-complete - only run at all if originalVcfInstallerAvailable is false). Only 4 are pre-approved below, on purpose: this demonstrates SELECTIVE answering - a gate whose key is omitted always still blocks for a real Enter press, even with this answer file loaded and every other cmdlet running unattended. 'vcfms-binary-staging-complete', 'vcfa-binary-staging-complete' and 'license-server-redeployed' are deliberately left OUT here as an example of gates an operator might always want to confirm by hand regardless of what else is automated.

Run each task interactively once first to see its real prompts/IDs, then transcribe your answers here in the same order. An invalid or missing answer fails the run immediately rather than hanging (except Confirm-ManualStep, which is designed to fall back to a real prompt on any key not listed).
